# URL Metadata Fetcher

> URL Metadata Fetcher is a free web tool by Dotan Veretzky that inspects, audits, and exports the Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD, and HTML metadata a public page publishes about itself.

## About

- [Dotan Veretzky](https://dotanv.vercel.app/): software engineer, game developer, web and AI developer. Author of URL Metadata Fetcher.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dotan-v/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DotanVG)
- [Personal site](https://dotanv.vercel.app/)

## App

- [Live app](https://react-node-url-mdata-fetch-dotanv.netlify.app/): paste one URL or a batch of up to 20, then export JSON or CSV.
- [API](https://react-node-url-metadata-fetcher.onrender.com/): public metadata extraction API used by the app.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/DotanVG/react-node-url-metadata-fetcher)
- [README](https://github.com/DotanVG/react-node-url-metadata-fetcher/blob/main/README.md): architecture, API reference, and local setup.
